mapper.select: select distinct a.id from cms_activity a join club_personal_payout_beneficiary b on b.scope_type = 'ACTIVITY' and b.scope_id = a.id join cms_registration r on r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id join ecom_order_seller s on cast(s.out_trade_no as binary) = cast(r.registration_no as binary) where b.payout_ready_at is not null and a.del_flag = 0 and s.transaction_id is not null and exists (select 1 from settlement_detail d where d.source_type = 'registration' and d.source_id = r.id and not exists (select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = r.id and h.status = 0) and d.club_id = b.club_id and d.receiver_id = b.member_id and d.status in (0,1)) and not exists (select 1 from ecom_profit_share_order o where o.out_trade_no = s.out_trade_no and o.topic_id = -a.id) order by a.id limit #{limit}

select s.out_trade_no as outTradeNo, s.sub_mchid as subMchid, s.seller_type as sellerType, s.seller_id as sellerId, s.total_fen as totalFen, s.transaction_id as transactionId, r.id as registrationId from cms_registration r join ecom_order_seller s on cast(s.out_trade_no as binary) = cast(r.registration_no as binary) join club_personal_payout_beneficiary b on b.scope_type = 'ACTIVITY' and b.scope_id = r.owner_id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and s.transaction_id is not null and b.payout_ready_at is not null and not exists (select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = r.id and h.status = 0) order by r.id

select -d.id as settlementId, d.receiver_type as lineType, case when d.receiver_type = 'platform' then 'ACCOUNTING' else 'MEMBER' end as receiverKind, case when d.receiver_type = 'platform' then null else d.receiver_id end as receiverMemberId, d.settlement_amount as originalAmount, d.club_id as clubId, d.club_name as clubName from settlement_detail d join cms_registration r on r.id = d.source_id and r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} join club_personal_payout_beneficiary b on b.scope_type = 'ACTIVITY' and b.scope_id = r.owner_id where d.source_type = 'registration' and d.source_id = #{registrationId} and d.status in (0,1) and b.payout_ready_at is not null order by d.id
mapper.update: update settlement_detail d join ecom_profit_share_line l on l.settlement_id = -d.id join ecom_profit_share_order o on o.id = l.share_order_id set d.status = 1, d.fail_reason = null, d.update_time = now() where o.id = #{shareOrderId} and o.topic_id < 0 and o.state = 'SUCCESS' and d.status = 0

update cms_activity a join ecom_profit_share_order o on o.topic_id = -a.id and o.id = #{shareOrderId} and o.state = 'SUCCESS' join club_personal_payout_beneficiary b on b.scope_type = 'ACTIVITY' and b.scope_id = a.id set a.is_settlement = 1 where a.is_settlement = 0 and a.del_flag = 0 and b.payout_ready_at is not null and exists (select 1 from cms_registration r join settlement_detail d on d.source_type = 'registration' and d.source_id = r.id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id and d.club_id = b.club_id and d.receiver_id = b.member_id and d.status = 1) and not exists (select 1 from cms_registration r join settlement_detail d on d.source_type = 'registration' and d.source_id = r.id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id and d.status = 0) and not exists (select 1 from cms_registration r join cms_activity_settlement_hold h on h.registration_id = r.id and h.status = 0 where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id)
